title: Desk Guidance: Correcting the Recipient Name on a Cash Pickup Transfer
content:
## Scope

The recipient name on a Cash Pickup transfer can be corrected only for spelling, so that it matches the recipient's government ID. Paying a different person requires cancelling the transfer and booking again.

## Status of the transfer

A name correction can be made only while the Cash Pickup transfer is awaiting funds, on hold or ready for pickup. An expired pickup must first be reactivated. A transfer that is paid out, cancelled or refunded can no longer be corrected. The transfer's status on record decides this.

| Status on record | Correction |
|---|---|
| awaiting funds | may be made |
| on hold | may be made |
| ready for pickup | may be made |
| expired | must first be reactivated |
| paid out, cancelled, refunded | can no longer be made |

## Number of corrections

A transfer may receive at most the tier's largest number of name corrections in total. The count is the name corrections recorded on that transfer, including the new one.

Hypothetical tier figure of 2:

| Corrections already recorded | Count including the new one | New correction |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | within the cap |
| 1 | 2 | within the cap |
| 2 | 3 | over the cap |

## Recording

The corrected name is recorded exactly as the customer gives it, and it replaces the recipient name on the transfer at once. The customer's saved recipient record is updated by the customer in the app, never by the correction.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of the former Cash Pickup name-correction rule are **no longer in force**:

1. The clause allowing the corrected name to differ from the current recipient name by at most the tier's correctable characters, counted as single-character insertions, deletions or substitutions with only letter case ignored, a larger difference being a different person.
2. The clause under which the tier's free corrections carried no fee and each later correction carried the tier's listed name-correction fee as a charge numbered with its correction number.
3. The clause under which the Pickup Number and the pickup window do not change on a correction.

The tier's figures for correctable characters, free corrections, the listed fee and the most corrections remain those in the Cash Pickup tier schedule.

superseded_clauses: The first free_name_corrections corrections are free and each later one carries name_correction_fee_usd as fee_type name_correction_fee with fee_seq equal to its correction_seq.

The corrected name may differ from the current recipient_name_on_transfer by at most name_correction_max_chars characters, counted as single-character insertions, deletions or substitutions, letter case ignored; a correction of more characters is a different person.
the Pickup Number and pickup window do not change.
